question: Which philosophical work did Rammohan Roy write in 1803 analysing world religions through reason and social relevance?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Tuhfat-ul Muwahhidin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tuhfat-ul Muwahhidin**, written by **Rammohan Roy**, is a significant philosophical work published in **1803**.
 
• This book is an **analysis of world religions** through the lens of **reason** and **social relevance**.
